name: Video & Media Downloader (YouTube / yt-dlp)
description: High-performance media downloader supporting YouTube, Soundcloud, Vimeo, and 1000+ sites via yt-dlp.

url.title: Media / Video URL
url.description: Direct URL of the video, playlist, stream, or audio to download (YouTube, Soundcloud, Vimeo, Twitch, etc.)

download_mode.title: Download Mode
download_mode.description: Select whether to download complete video, extract audio only, or video only.

extract_audio.title: Extract Audio
extract_audio.description: Convert video directly to audio file via FFmpeg

keep_video.title: Keep Original Video
keep_video.description: Retain video file on disk after extracting audio

embed_thumbnail.title: Embed Thumbnail Cover Art
embed_thumbnail.description: Embed video thumbnail into audio/video file metadata

write_thumbnail.title: Save Thumbnail Image
write_thumbnail.description: Save video thumbnail as separate JPG/PNG file

embed_metadata.title: Embed Metadata & Chapters
embed_metadata.description: Write video title, uploader, date, and chapter markers into media tags

playlist_items.title: Playlist Item Selection
playlist_items.description: Comma-separated playlist indices or range to download

no_playlist.title: Single Video Only (Ignore Playlist)
no_playlist.description: Download only the referenced video if URL points to a playlist

max_downloads.title: Max Downloads Limit
max_downloads.description: Maximum number of files to download from a playlist/channel

concurrent_fragments.title: Concurrent Fragments
concurrent_fragments.description: Number of parallel threads for dash/hls stream downloads

cookies_from_browser.title: Browser Cookies (Anti-403)
cookies_from_browser.description: Load session cookies directly from browser to bypass 403 Forbidden / bot checks

cookies_file.title: Cookies File Path
cookies_file.description: Path to Netscape formatted cookies.txt file

extractor_args.title: Extractor Arguments (Player Client)
extractor_args.description: Override player clients or pass PO tokens (e.g. youtube:player_client=mweb)

restrict_filenames.title: Sanitize Filenames (ASCII Only)
restrict_filenames.description: Restrict output filename to ASCII characters and avoid spaces
